<section

  data-gemini-id="confirmacion-texto"
  path="placeholder"

  memory_type="background"

>
  <style>
    @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..144,300..600;1,9..144,300..600&family=Figtree:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');

    .ptr-con, .ptr-con *, .ptr-con *::before, .ptr-con *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
    .ptr-con {
      --t-bg: var(--bg-color, #FBF4E8);
      --t-tx: var(--text-color, #1D5A5E);
      --t-p: var(--primary-color, #1BB3AE);
      --t-s: var(--secondary-color, #138A6B);
      --t-a: var(--accent-color, #FF7A63);
      --t-sand: color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-bg) 55%, #E3C08C);
      --t-orchid: color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-a) 34%, #F7D4EC);
      --t-display: var(--font-script, 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif);
      --t-text: var(--font-heading, 'Figtree', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif);
      position: relative;
      isolation: isolate;
      min-height: clamp(32rem, 60vw, 46rem);
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      padding: clamp(4.5rem, 9vw, 7rem) clamp(1.25rem, 5vw, 4rem);
      overflow: hidden;
      overflow: clip;
      background-color: var(--t-bg);
      background-image: url('https://loremflickr.com/1600/1000/tropical,flowers,leaves?lock=3051');
      background-size: cover;
      background-position: center;
      color: var(--t-tx);
      font-family: var(--t-text);
    }
    .ptr-con::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: -1;
      background: radial-gradient(120% 90% at 70% 50%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-bg) 94%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-bg) 84%, transparent));
    }
    .ptr-con__wrap { width: min(100%, 66rem); display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, .9fr) minmax(0, 1.1fr); gap: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4.5rem); align-items: center; }
    .ptr-con__intro { position: relative; }
    .ptr-con__kicker { margin: 0; font-family: var(--t-display); font-style: italic; font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 2vw, 1.35rem); color: var(--t-a); }
    .ptr-con__title { margin: .2rem 0 0; font-family: var(--t-display); font-weight: 400; font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 144; font-size: clamp(2.3rem, 5vw, 3.7rem); line-height: 1.03; text-wrap: balance; }
    .ptr-con__text { margin: 1.1rem 0 0; max-width: 26rem; font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.65; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-tx) 84%, transparent); }
    .ptr-con__deadline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .6rem; margin: 1.3rem 0 0; padding: .55rem 1.1rem .55rem .7rem; border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-a) 14%, transparent); font-weight: 600; font-size: .98rem; color: var(--t-tx); }
    .ptr-con__deadline svg { width: 1.6rem; height: 1.6rem; color: var(--t-a); flex: none; }
    .ptr-con__flora { position: relative; width: clamp(9rem, 18vw, 13rem); margin-top: 1.5rem; }
    .ptr-con__flora svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; overflow: visible; }
    .ptr-con__flora-leaf { color: var(--t-s); transform: rotate(-24deg); }
    .ptr-con__flora-orch { position: absolute; width: 34%; right: -14%; top: 30%; }
    .ptr-con__flora-orch--2 { width: 24%; right: 18%; top: 66%; transform: rotate(-30deg); }

    .ptr-con__card {
      position: relative;
      padding: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 2.75rem);
      border-radius: 1.75rem;
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-bg) 70%, #ffffff);
      box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -36px color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-tx) 55%, transparent), 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-tx) 8%, transparent);
    }
    .ptr-con__card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: .7rem; border-radius: 1.25rem; border: 1.5px dashed color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-p) 45%, transparent); pointer-events: none; }
    .ptr-con__stamp { position: absolute; top: -1.1rem; right: 1.4rem; width: 4.4rem; padding: .45rem; background: var(--t-bg); border: 2px dotted color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-a) 70%, transparent); border-radius: .4rem; transform: rotate(7deg); box-shadow: 0 8px 18px -10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-tx) 50%, transparent); color: var(--t-a); }
    .ptr-con__stamp svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; }
    .ptr-con__form { position: relative; display: grid; gap: 1.1rem; }
    .ptr-con__row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.6fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 1rem; }
    .ptr-con__field { display: grid; gap: .4rem; text-align: left; }
    .ptr-con__label, .ptr-con__legend { font-weight: 600; font-size: .95rem; color: var(--t-tx); padding: 0; }
    .ptr-con__field input,
    .ptr-con__field textarea {
      width: 100%;
      min-height: 3rem;
      padding: .75rem 1rem;
      border: 1.5px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-tx) 18%, transparent);
      border-radius: .95rem;
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-bg) 55%, #ffffff);
      color: var(--t-tx);
      font: inherit;
      font-size: 1rem;
      transition: border-color .3s ease, box-shadow .3s ease;
    }
    .ptr-con__field textarea { resize: vertical; min-height: 5.5rem; }
    .ptr-con__field input:focus,
    .ptr-con__field textarea:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--t-p); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-p) 22%, transparent); }
    .ptr-con__field input[data-invalid] { border-color: var(--t-a); animation: ptr-con-shake .4s ease; }
    .ptr-con__att { margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; display: grid; gap: .5rem; text-align: left; }
    .ptr-con__pills { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .6rem; }
    .ptr-con__pill { position: relative; flex: 1 1 10rem; }
    .ptr-con__pill input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; inset: 0; margin: 0; cursor: pointer; }
    .ptr-con__pill-face {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: .5rem;
      min-height: 3rem;
      padding: .6rem 1rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1.5px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-tx) 20%, transparent);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: .98rem;
      color: var(--t-tx);
      transition: background-color .3s ease, color .3s ease, border-color .3s ease, transform .3s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.6, .4, 1);
    }
    .ptr-con__pill-face::before { content: ''; width: .7rem; height: .7rem; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid currentColor; transition: background-color .3s ease, transform .3s ease; }
    .ptr-con__pill input:checked + .ptr-con__pill-face { background: var(--t-p); border-color: var(--t-p); color: var(--t-bg); transform: scale(1.03); }
    .ptr-con__pill input:checked + .ptr-con__pill-face::before { background: currentColor; transform: scale(.85); }
    .ptr-con__pill--no input:checked + .ptr-con__pill-face { background: var(--t-a); border-color: var(--t-a); }
    .ptr-con__pill input:focus-visible + .ptr-con__pill-face { outline: 3px solid var(--t-a); outline-offset: 3px; }
    .ptr-con__pill:hover .ptr-con__pill-face { border-color: var(--t-p); }

    .ptr-con__btnwrap { position: relative; margin-top: .4rem; }
    .ptr-con__btn {
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 100%;
      min-height: 3.4rem;
      padding: .8rem 1.4rem;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--t-tx);
      color: var(--t-bg);
      font: inherit;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: background-color .4s ease, transform .3s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.5, .4, 1);
    }
    .ptr-con__btn:hover { background: var(--t-s); transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .ptr-con__btn:active { transform: scale(.98); }
    .ptr-con__btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--t-a); outline-offset: 3px; }
    .ptr-con__btn[data-state="loading"] { background: var(--t-p); cursor: progress; }
    .ptr-con__btn[data-state="done"] { background: var(--t-s); }
    .ptr-con__st { display: none; align-items: center; gap: .6rem; }
    .ptr-con__btn[data-state="idle"] .ptr-con__st--idle,
    .ptr-con__btn[data-state="loading"] .ptr-con__st--load,
    .ptr-con__btn[data-state="done"] .ptr-con__st--done { display: inline-flex; }
    .ptr-con__dots { display: inline-flex; gap: .25rem; }
    .ptr-con__dots i { width: .45rem; height: .45rem; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; animation: ptr-con-bob .42s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
    .ptr-con__dots i:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .14s; }
    .ptr-con__dots i:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: .28s; }
    .ptr-con__st--done svg { width: 1.5rem; height: 1.5rem; color: var(--t-orchid); animation: ptr-con-pop .45s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.6, .4, 1); }
    .ptr-con__burst { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: 0; height: 0; pointer-events: none; }
    .ptr-con__petal { position: absolute; left: -.35rem; top: -.25rem; width: .7rem; height: .5rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--t-a); opacity: 1; transform: translate(0, 0) rotate(0); transition: transform .5s cubic-bezier(.15, .8, .3, 1), opacity .5s ease; }
    .ptr-con__petal:nth-child(3n) { background: var(--t-p); }
    .ptr-con__petal:nth-child(3n+1) { background: var(--t-orchid); }
    .ptr-con__petal[data-go] { transform: translate(var(--dx), var(--dy)) rotate(var(--rot)); opacity: 0; }
    .ptr-con__live { margin: 0; min-height: 1.4em; font-size: .92rem; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-tx) 80%, transparent); text-align: center; }

    @keyframes ptr-con-bob { from { transform: translateY(2px); opacity: .5; } to { transform: translateY(-4px); opacity: 1; } }
    @keyframes ptr-con-pop { from { transform: scale(0) rotate(-120deg); } to { transform: scale(1) rotate(0); } }
    @keyframes ptr-con-shake { 0%, 100% { transform: translateX(0); } 25% { transform: translateX(-6px); } 50% { transform: translateX(5px); } 75% { transform: translateX(-3px); } }

    .ptr-con--anim .ptr-con__card { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px) rotate(2.5deg); transition: opacity .45s ease, transform .5s cubic-bezier(.2, .9, .3, 1.15); }
    .ptr-con--anim .ptr-con__stamp { opacity: 0; transform: rotate(40deg) scale(1.6); transition: opacity .3s ease .35s, transform .45s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.4, .4, 1) .35s; }
    .ptr-con--anim .ptr-con__intro { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-18px); transition: opacity .45s ease, transform .5s cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1); }
    .ptr-con--anim.is-in .ptr-con__card { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
    .ptr-con--anim.is-in .ptr-con__stamp { opacity: 1; transform: rotate(7deg); }
    .ptr-con--anim.is-in .ptr-con__intro { opacity: 1; transform: none; }

    @media (max-width: 820px) {
      .ptr-con__wrap { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
      .ptr-con__intro { text-align: center; }
      .ptr-con__text { margin-inline: auto; }
      .ptr-con__flora { display: none; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 460px) {
      .ptr-con__row { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
    }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .ptr-con *, .ptr-con *::before, .ptr-con *::after { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; }
    }
  </style>

modules.description: Módulo detalles del set tropical
modules.html_content:
Para que solo pienses en disfrutar

Detalles importantes

Ceremonia en la arena

Te sugerimos sandalias o calzado bajo; habrá un rincón para dejar tus zapatos.

Clima de playa

Esperamos alrededor de 28 °C y brisa marina. Trae lentes de sol y protector biodegradable.

Hospedaje

Tenemos tarifa preferencial en hoteles cercanos. Escríbenos y te compartimos el código.

Celebración para adultos

Con mucho cariño, hemos pensado esta noche solo para adultos.

<section
  class="rr-ub"
  data-gemini-id="ubicacion-mapa"
  path="placeholder"
  memory_source="generated"
  memory_type="background"
  memory_usage="protected"
>
  <style>
    @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Allura&family=EB+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;1,400;1,500&display=swap');

    .rr-ub, .rr-ub *, .rr-ub *::before, .rr-ub *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
    .rr-ub {
      --t-bg: var(--bg-color, #F3EDE1);
      --t-tx: var(--text-color, #3A2B1F);
      --t-p: var(--primary-color, #8B9E7C);
      --t-s: var(--secondary-color, #9A7350);
      --t-a: var(--accent-color, #EDBC68);
      --t-display: var(--font-script, 'Allura', cursive);
      --t-text: var(--font-heading, 'EB Garamond', Georgia, serif);
      --t-wood: color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-s) 82%, #2b1c11);
      --t-wood-d: color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-s) 34%, #170f09);
      --t-sage-d: color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-p) 58%, #1d261a);
      --t-sage-l: color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-p) 55%, var(--t-bg));
      --t-ivory: color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-bg) 70%, #ffffff);
      --t-twine: color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-s) 50%, #dcc7a4);
      position: relative;
      isolation: isolate;
      min-height: clamp(32rem, 60vw, 44rem);
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      padding: clamp(5rem, 9vw, 7rem) clamp(1.25rem, 5vw, 4rem);
      overflow: hidden;
      background-color: var(--t-wood-d);
      background-image: url('https://loremflickr.com/1600/1000/barn,countryside?lock=3031');
      background-size: cover;
      background-position: center;
      color: var(--t-bg);
      text-align: left;
      font-family: var(--t-text);
    }
    .rr-ub::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: -1;
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 60% at 30% 50%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-a) 12%, transparent), transparent 70%),
        linear-gradient(105deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-wood-d) 90%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-wood) 72%, transparent) 55%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-wood-d) 92%, transparent));
    }
    .rr-ub__grain { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; z-index: -1; pointer-events: none; mix-blend-mode: multiply; opacity: .55; will-change: transform; }
    .rr-ub__grain { opacity: .5; }
    .rr-ub__wrap { width: min(100%, 66rem); display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.1fr) minmax(0, .9fr); gap: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 5rem); align-items: center; }
    .rr-ub__map {
      position: relative;
      padding: .85rem;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 10%, rgba(255, 255, 255, .5), transparent 60%), repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-s) 7%, transparent) 0 1px, transparent 1px 4px), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-s) 6%, transparent) 0 1px, transparent 1px 5px), var(--t-ivory);
      border-radius: 4px;
      transform: rotate(-1.6deg);
      box-shadow: 0 1.8rem 3rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .5);
    }
    .rr-ub__map::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: .85rem; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-s) 30%, transparent); pointer-events: none; }
    .rr-ub__mapsvg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; }
    .rr-ub__euca { position: absolute; width: clamp(5rem, 11vw, 7.5rem); height: auto; right: -2.4rem; bottom: -3rem; transform: rotate(-140deg); filter: drop-shadow(0 .4rem .5rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .35)); pointer-events: none; }
    .rr-ub__title { margin: 0; font-family: var(--t-display); font-weight: 400; font-size: clamp(3rem, 6.5vw, 4.5rem); line-height: 1; color: var(--t-sage-l); }
    .rr-ub__venue { margin: .9rem 0 .5rem; font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3.4vw, 2rem); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.2; }
    .rr-ub__addr { font-style: normal; font-size: 1.12rem; line-height: 1.6; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-bg) 92%, transparent); }
    .rr-ub__addr p { margin: 0; }
    .rr-ub__note { margin: 1rem 0 1.9rem; max-width: 26rem; font-style: italic; line-height: 1.55; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-bg) 78%, transparent); }
    .rr-ub__btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: .7rem;
      min-height: 3.2rem;
      padding: .7rem 1.5rem;
      border-radius: 3px;
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 1.12rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--t-wood-d);
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-a) 62%, #fff4dc), color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-a) 88%, var(--t-s)));
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, .3), 0 .6rem 1.4rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .35), 0 0 1.6rem color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-a) 35%, transparent);
      transition: transform .3s ease, box-shadow .3s ease;
    }
    .rr-ub__btn:hover, .rr-ub__btn:focus-visible { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, .4), 0 .9rem 1.8rem rgba(0, 0, 0, .4), 0 0 2.8rem color-mix(in srgb, var(--t-a) 60%, transparent); outline: none; }
    .rr-ub__arrow { width: 1.2rem; height: 1.2rem; transition: transform .3s ease; }
    .rr-ub__btn:hover .rr-ub__arrow { transform: translateX(4px); }

    @media (max-width: 52rem) {
      .rr-ub__wrap { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
      .rr-ub__map { transform: rotate(-1deg); }
      .rr-ub__euca { right: -1.4rem; width: 5rem; }
    }

    .rr-ub--anim .rr-ub__map { transition: opacity .45s ease, transform .5s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.3, .5, 1); }
    .rr-ub--anim .rr-ub__info { transition: opacity .45s ease .15s, transform .5s ease .15s; }
    .rr-ub--anim:not(.is-in) .rr-ub__map { opacity: 0; transform: rotate(-7deg) translateY(1.6rem); }
    .rr-ub--anim:not(.is-in) .rr-ub__info { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(1.2rem); }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .rr-ub *, .rr-ub *::before, .rr-ub *::after { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; }
    }
  </style>

modules.description: Módulo itinerario del set rustico
modules.html_content:
Así será nuestro día

De la tarde a la noche, cada momento se irá encendiendo como una luz más en la cadena.

  1. 5:00 p.m.

    Ceremonia

    Bajo el arco de madera y eucalipto, frente a nuestras familias.

  2. 6:00 p.m.

    Cóctel en el jardín

    Bebidas de temporada, música acústica y la última luz del atardecer.

  3. 7:30 p.m.

    Cena campestre

    Mesas largas de madera, velas encendidas y un menú para compartir.

  4. 9:00 p.m.

    Primer baile

    Cuando se enciendan todas las luces, será nuestro momento.

  5. 9:30 p.m.

    Fiesta

    A bailar entre el granero y la pista bajo el cielo abierto.

  6. 1:00 a.m.

    Despedida

    Un camino de bengalas para cerrar la noche juntos.

modules.description: Módulo detalles del set rustico
modules.html_content:
Detalles para disfrutar

Pequeñas notas para que vivas la celebración al aire libre con toda comodidad.

Jardín y pasto

La ceremonia será sobre pasto; te recomendamos tacón ancho o calzado plano.

Noche fresca

Al caer el sol refresca. Un chal o un saco ligero será tu mejor aliado para disfrutar la noche bajo las luces.

Celebración para adultos

Con todo cariño, pensamos esta noche solo para adultos. Gracias por comprender.

Estacionamiento

Habrá estacionamiento y servicio de valet a la entrada de la hacienda.

modules.description: Módulo itinerario del set mariposas-noche
modules.html_content:
Itinerario

Así florecerá nuestra noche, momento a momento.

  1. 5:00 p. m.

    Misa de acción de gracias

    Parroquia de Nuestra Señora, para dar gracias por mis quince primaveras.

  2. 7:00 p. m.

    Recepción

    Bienvenida en el jardín entre rosas, música y mariposas.

  3. 8:00 p. m.

    Vals

    Mi primer baile con papá y mi corte de honor.

  4. 9:00 p. m.

    Cena

    Menú de tres tiempos bajo las luces del jardín.

  5. 10:00 p. m.

    Baile sorpresa

    Un momento lleno de color preparado con mucho cariño.

  6. 10:30 p. m.

    ¡A bailar!

    La pista se abre hasta que las mariposas se vayan a dormir.
